taps.name: Azacca IPA
taps.description: Azacca IPA - the base of this beer was a BUZZ Big Brew Day IPA. It was singularly hopped with azacca for bittering to 30 IBU and dry hopped with 1oz. I later added 3ml of an Azacca concentrate that comes through in the aroma. This beer will be succeeded by a NZ Pils

taps.name: Festbier
taps.description: Festbier - robust in strength and flavor, make sure the CO2 is on and carbonation is good

taps.name: Dry Irish stout
taps.description: Dry Irish stout, kegged Feb 2025 and still good. Nearly done, so get it while it lasts. Yell at Leo if nothing pours, that means he never moved it!

taps.name: Non-alcoholic cherry seltzer (caffeinated)
taps.description: Non-alcoholic cherry seltzer. It's caffeinated, so go easy for kids or late in the evening.

taps.name: Nitro Coffee & Vanilla English Dark Mild (dark roast coffee, no vanilla)
taps.description: Session-strength English dark mild (~3% ABV) conditioned on dark-roast coffee, no vanilla. Served on nitro, so it's smooth and light-bodied.

taps.name: Belgian Dark Strong (barrel-aged)
taps.description: Belgian Dark Strong - still very good 2+ years aged
